providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26) via USGS search + web search: no controlled global photomosaic exists for Amalthea (Galileo imaged it only partially, at closer range than any other Jovian moon, but the coverage was never assembled into a global map). Procedural texture: deep red base color reflecting its real status as the reddest known object in the Solar System (redder than Mars), attributed to sulfur dust from Io.
